title: چرا ژل ناخن زود می‌پره؟ ۵ دلیل
accuracy: Educational claims must stay general and cautious: these are COMMON reasons for gel lifting (skin/oil left on the nail surface, thick or under-cured layers, unsealed free edge, using nails as tools). Do not promise exact durations or medical results.
goal: High-save, high-share educational reel in the cartoon style. 30-38 s. Hook in 1 s, one reason per scene, 'save + send' CTA, loop back to the opening.

scenes.idea: MOTION HIGH. Gely proudly sticks onto a nail and high-fives Nailie with sparkles; time-lapse of calendar pages flipping and the sky changing; Gely slowly peels and tumbles off with a comedic bounce; Nailie's eyes go huge. Title question slams in with screen shake. Whip-pan to the next scene.

scenes.text: دلیل اول: چربی نامرئی روی سطح ناخن
scenes.idea: Oily, a slick shiny yellow blob, lounges on the nail surface making rainbow sheen puddles; Gely runs in, tries to stick, slips on the oil like on ice, squeaky cartoon slide across the whole frame; Nailie holds a cleansing pad, too late. Camera tracks the slide, speed lines.

scenes.text: دلیل دوم: پوست نازکی که روی ناخن می‌مونه
scenes.idea: Skinny, a thin ghost-like transparent film blob, clings innocently to the nail; Gely sticks onto Skinny, thinking it is the nail; Skinny peels away at the corner and floats off carrying Gely like a flag in the wind. Camera follows with a rack focus. Funny panic face.

scenes.text: دلیل سوم: لایه‌ی ضخیم و کم‌پخت
scenes.idea: Thicc, a chubby layer blob packed with bubbles, wobbles like jelly; the UV lamp beams its light but only the crust cures, shown as light rays stopping at the top while the doughy core stays soft; Thicc sags and collapses with a splat and bubbles popping. Cross-section cutaway view in cartoon style.

scenes.text: دلیل چهارم: لبه‌ی ناخن که سیل نشده
scenes.idea: Drippy, a tiny blue water-droplet ninja, sneaks under the unsealed edge of the nail in stealth style (spotlight sweep); Gely tries to close the door; Nailie swipes a gold cap line along the edge, door slams shut with a clink and Drippy bounces off with a comedic boing. Macro push-in.

scenes.text: دلیل پنجم: استفاده از ناخن به‌جای ابزار
scenes.idea: Can-Tab smirks; a nail used as a lever pries the tab; red stress lines flash, a crack zigzags through Gely, who shatters into cartoon sparkles and puffs (no gore) in slow motion with screen shake; Nailie facepalms, sweat drop.

scenes.text: اجرای درست، به ماندگاری بیشتر کمک می‌کنه
scenes.idea: Resolution: everything done right, Gely hugs the nail tightly with a happy face, glossy shine sweeps across, sparkles, calendar flips fast again but Gely stays put; Nailie thumbs-up; camera crane-up. Warm color shift.

scenes.text: ذخیره کن و برای کسی بفرست که ناخنش همیشه می‌پره
scenes.idea: Nailie and Gely hold a big bookmark and a send arrow, point at the viewer together; the arrow flies off; quick match-cut loop back to the opening high-five; end-card @ayda.nailroom.

format: Same cartoon world as scenarios 01-04 (round blob characters, navy/violet background, plush shading, cinematic camera moves). Educational comedy: each reason is a cute villain that makes Gely slip off. Higher motion, one clear visual explanation per scene. Not childish: witty, fast, modern.

cast.name: Nailie
cast.desc: round pink blob, tiny nail-brush antenna with a gel-drop tip, big glossy eyes, long glossy almond-nail hands in close-ups

cast.name: Gely
cast.desc: cute translucent amber gel-drop blob, determined sticky hero who just wants to hold on

cast.name: Oily
cast.desc: slick shiny yellow oil blob that makes everything slippery

cast.name: Skinny
cast.desc: thin translucent ghost-like film blob that clings and peels

cast.name: Thicc
cast.desc: chubby layer blob full of bubbles with a raw doughy core
